format: HGSS Black Star Promos (HSP HGSS01-HGSS25, 2010-2011): every card came out before Black & White, so the set is Unlimited only. Feraligatr, Meganium and Typhlosion are Pokémon Prime (no special rules).

attacks.name: Sacred Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Aeroblast
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Recharge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Tenacious Bind
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is [C][C] more.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

abilities.name: Night Scope
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at your opponent's hand. Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Rain Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Water Pokémon. Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Crunch
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Leaf Trans
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Grass Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

abilities.name: Afterburner
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. Not while this Pokémon has a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Flare Destroy
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to this Pokémon and an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Infinite Wind
attacks.text: If Latios is on your Bench, remove 2 damage counters from each of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Luster Float
abilities.text: If you have Latias in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Infinite Wing
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is Asleep, prevent all damage done to it by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. This Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is Asleep, prevent all damage done to it by attacks.

attacks.name: Energy Antics
attacks.text: Move an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. This Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ferry
attacks.text: Put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand (show it to your opponent).

abilities.name: Fermenting Liquid
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, draw a card.

attacks.name: Shell Stunner
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.text: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.name: Tropical Tidal Wave
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Pokémon Tools and Stadium cards your opponent has in play. If tails, discard all Pokémon Tools and Stadium cards you have in play.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sheer Cold
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Version Update
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Porygon2, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

abilities.name: Shortcut
abilities.text: The Retreat Cost of each Porygon, Porygon2 and Porygon-Z you have in play is [C] less.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
